items.name: Basic form name
items.renders: Not rendered; descriptive record name used to reference the form (web page lookup or Liquid).
items.notes: Required.

items.name: Basic form table name
items.renders: Selects the Dataverse table whose form is loaded and whose record is created, edited or read.
items.notes: Required. Table reference display name: Table Name.

items.name: Basic form form name
items.renders: Selects the Dataverse form on the target table whose layout (tabs, sections, fields) is rendered.
items.notes: Required.

items.name: Basic form tab name
items.renders: Renders only the named tab of the Dataverse form.
items.notes: Optional. If not specified (and steps are not auto-generated), the first tab is displayed.

items.name: Basic form mode
items.renders: Determines whether the form creates a new record, edits an existing record or shows an existing record non-editable.
items.notes: default: Insert (DefaultFormValue 100000000). Edit and ReadOnly require a source record located via Record Source Type and Record ID Parameter Name.

items.name: Basic form mode: Insert
items.renders: Empty editable form; submission inserts a new record.
items.notes: In Insert mode you can't change a button's alignment or place an action button above the form (Learn considerations).

items.name: Basic form mode: Edit
items.renders: Editable form data-bound to an existing record; submission updates it.
items.notes: Requires an existing source record (Record Source Type + Record ID Parameter Name).

items.name: Basic form mode: ReadOnly
items.renders: Non-editable display of an existing record.
items.notes: Requires an existing source record. Business rules and client API can enable locked fields on a read-only form. With geolocation enabled the address field is replaced by the map.

items.name: Basic form record source type
values: Record Associated to Current Portal User=756150003
items.renders: Determines how the record for Edit/ReadOnly is located when the form loads.
items.notes: No default (DefaultFormValue -1). Table reference display name: Table Source Type.

items.name: Basic form record source type: Query String
items.renders: Record ID is read from the URL query string parameter named by Record ID Parameter Name.
items.notes: Requires Record ID Parameter Name.

items.name: Basic form record source type: Current Portal User
items.renders: Binds the form to the portal user record of the signed-in user.
items.notes: Requires an authenticated user.

items.name: Basic form record source type: Record Associated to Current Portal User
values: Record Associated to Current Portal User=756150003
items.renders: Retrieves the signed-in user's record, then the related record via Relationship Name.
items.notes: Requires Relationship Name; Allow Create If Null available.

items.name: Basic form record ID parameter name
items.renders: Name of the query string parameter on the page URL that supplies the record ID.
items.notes: Used with Record Source Type Query String. List/subgrid actions pass the ID with their own Record ID Parameter Name, which must match; Learn states the default is id.

items.name: Basic form relationship name
items.renders: Relationship from the current portal user record to the target record used to find the record to bind.
items.notes: Required when Record Source Type is Record Associated to Current Portal User; must return the table type in Table Name.

items.name: Basic form allow create if null
items.renders: If the related record doesn't exist, the user can create it the first time instead of an exception being thrown.
items.notes: default: false. Only with Record Source Type Record Associated to Current Portal User. Not available in multistep forms.

items.name: Basic form enable table permissions
items.renders: Form respects table permissions; users without explicit permissions get an error message. When disabled a warning is shown.
items.notes: Learn text says default false for backwards compatibility; the table reference lists DefaultValue True. Learn marks this method of securing forms as soon to be deprecated.

items.name: Basic form add captcha
items.renders: Displays a captcha on the form.
items.notes: default: false. Table reference display name: Captcha Required.

items.name: Basic form show captcha for authenticated users
items.renders: Displays the captcha also for signed-in users.
items.notes: default: false. Design studio offers captcha for anonymous users, authenticated users or both.

items.name: Basic form validation group
items.renders: Group name assigned to input controls for evaluating valid input of named groups.
items.notes: Free text.

items.name: Basic form auto generate steps from tabs
items.renders: Each tab of the Dataverse form is shown as a sequential step until the final submission inserts the record.
items.notes: default: false; when false only one tab (Tab Name, or the first tab) is rendered.

items.name: Basic form render web resources inline
items.renders: Web resources on the form render inline instead of inside an iframe.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Basic form tooltips enabled
items.renders: Field tooltips use the description of the attribute on the target table.
items.notes: default: false. Table reference display name: ToolTip Enabled.

items.name: Basic form show unsupported fields
items.renders: Shows or hides columns of unsupported Dataverse column types.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Basic form set recommended fields as required
items.renders: Fields with requirement level Business Recommended become required.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Basic form make all fields required
items.renders: All fields become required regardless of requirement level.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Basic form validation summary CSS class
items.renders: CSS class applied to the validation summary block.
items.notes: default: 'validation-summary alert alert-error alert-block'.

items.name: Basic form enable validation summary links
items.renders: Validation summary items render anchor links that scroll to the field in error.
items.notes: default: true.

items.name: Basic form validation summary link text
items.renders: Label of the validation summary links.
items.notes: default: 'click here'. Requires Enable Validation Summary Links.

items.name: Basic form validation summary header text
items.renders: Header label of the validation summary.
items.notes: Free text; Learn states no default.

items.name: Basic form instructions
items.renders: Instructions text displayed with the form (load-form-step page: a block of text at the top of the form).
items.notes: Free text (Memo).

items.name: Basic form record not found message
items.renders: Message shown when the source record is not found.
items.notes: Load-form-step page gives default: The record you're looking for couldn't be found.

items.name: Basic form on success
items.renders: Determines what happens after a successful submission.
items.notes: default: Display Success Message (756150000).

items.name: Basic form on success: Display Success Message
items.renders: After submit the success message is displayed.
items.notes: Enables Hide Form on Success and Success Message.

items.name: Basic form on success: Redirect
items.renders: After submit the browser is redirected to an external URL or a site web page.
items.notes: Enables External URL / Web Page and the query string options.

items.name: Basic form hide form on success
items.renders: Form is hidden after successful submission.
items.notes: Requires On Success = Display Success Message. Table reference DefaultValue True.

items.name: Basic form success message
items.renders: Message displayed after successful submission.
items.notes: Requires On Success = Display Success Message. default: "Submission completed successfully". Localizable per enabled language.

items.name: Basic form redirect external URL
items.renders: Redirect target URL after success.
items.notes: Requires On Success = Redirect. Alternative to Web Page.

items.name: Basic form redirect web page
items.renders: Redirect target web page of the current site after success.
items.notes: Requires On Success = Redirect. Lookup to a web page (relationship mspp_entityform_redirectwebpage).

items.name: Basic form append existing query string
items.renders: Existing query string parameters are added to the redirect target URL.
items.notes: default: false. Requires On Success = Redirect.

items.name: Basic form append record ID to query string
items.renders: ID of the record created is appended to the redirect URL query string.
items.notes: default: false. Requires On Success = Redirect. Table reference display name: Append Table ID To Query String.

items.name: Basic form redirect record ID parameter name
items.renders: Name of the ID parameter in the redirect URL query string.
items.notes: Requires On Success = Redirect. Learn does not name the column. The table reference has no column labelled Record ID Parameter Name for the redirect section; mspp_redirecturlquerystringname is described differently, so the mapping is unconfirmed.

items.name: Basic form redirect URL query string name
items.renders: Per the table reference: the redirect URL is dynamically retrieved from the query string using this parameter name.
items.notes: Only described in the table reference; not listed on the basic forms page.

items.name: Basic form append custom query string
items.renders: Custom string appended to the redirect URL query string.
items.notes: Requires On Success = Redirect. Table reference display name: Custom Query String.

items.name: Basic form append attribute value: parameter name
items.renders: Query string parameter name carrying a target-record attribute value on the redirect URL.
items.notes: Requires On Success = Redirect; used with Attribute Logical Name.

items.name: Basic form append attribute value: attribute logical name
items.renders: Attribute on the target table whose value is appended to the redirect URL.
items.notes: Requires On Success = Redirect; used with Parameter Name.

items.name: Basic form associate current portal user
items.renders: Signed-in user's record is associated with the target record on save.
items.notes: default: false. Requires Portal User Lookup Column.

items.name: Basic form portal user lookup column
items.renders: Attribute on the target table that stores the portal user.
items.notes: Used with Associate Current Portal User.

items.name: Basic form is activity party
items.renders: Treats the Portal User Lookup Column as an Activity Party type.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Basic form attach file
items.renders: Renders a file upload control at the bottom of the form to attach files to the record.
items.notes: default: false. With table permissions, the Attach File button needs annotation Create+Append and parent AppendTo privileges. Uploaded files can be shown via the timeline control.

items.name: Basic form attach file storage location
items.renders: Determines where uploaded files are stored.
items.notes: No default (DefaultFormValue -1); files are stored as note attachments unless Azure Storage is configured.

items.name: Basic form attach file storage location: Note Attachment
items.renders: Files saved as note attachments on the record.
items.notes: Behaviour when Azure Storage is not configured.

items.name: Basic form attach file storage location: Azure Blob Storage
items.renders: Files saved to Azure Blob Storage.
items.notes: Requires the organization to be configured for Azure Storage. Related columns mspp_storageaccountname and mspp_containername exist in the table reference without description.

items.name: Basic form attach file save option
items.renders: Not described on Learn beyond the choice labels.
items.notes: Only in the table reference; no rendering behavior stated. No default (-1).

items.name: Basic form allow multiple files
items.renders: File input accepts more than one file.
items.notes: default: false. Table reference also has mspp_maximumnooffiles (Maximum No Of Files, integer) without description.

items.name: Basic form attach file accept (MIME types)
items.renders: Sets the accept attribute (comma-separated MIME types, e.g. image/*) on the file input.
items.notes: Suggestion for the file dialog only, unless Restrict Files to Accepted Types is on. Table reference display name: Attach File MIME Type Accept.

items.name: Basic form attach file accept (extensions)
items.renders: Per the table reference: file extensions accepted by the upload, comma-separated (e.g. .docx,.pdf).
items.notes: Only described in the table reference.

items.name: Basic form attach file label
items.renders: Text displayed next to the file upload control.
items.notes: Localizable per enabled language.

items.name: Basic form attach file required
items.renders: Attaching a file becomes required to proceed.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Basic form attach file required error message
items.renders: Validation message when a required file is not attached.
items.notes: Requires Attach File Required. Localizable.

items.name: Basic form restrict files to accepted types
items.renders: Enforces validation of the uploaded file type against Accept.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Basic form file type error message
items.renders: Validation message for a disallowed file type.
items.notes: Requires Restrict Files to Accepted Types. Localizable.

items.name: Basic form maximum file size (KB)
items.renders: Enforces validation of the maximum uploaded file size in kilobytes.

items.name: Basic form file size error message
items.renders: Validation message when a file exceeds Maximum File Size.
items.notes: Requires Maximum File Size. Localizable.

items.name: Basic form custom JavaScript
items.renders: Script block added to the bottom of the page just before the closing form tag; field input IDs equal attribute logical names.
items.notes: Table reference display name: Custom JavaScript.

items.name: Basic form show owner fields
items.renders: Not described on Learn.
items.notes: Only in the table reference. default: false.

items.name: Basic form set table reference on save
items.renders: On save, the record is associated with a reference record.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Basic form table reference relationship name
items.renders: Relationship used to associate the saved record with the reference record.
items.notes: Load-form-step page: don't specify a relationship name if Target Lookup Attribute Logical Name is set.

items.name: Basic form table reference table logical name
items.renders: Logical name of the reference table.
items.notes: Requires Set Table Reference On Save.

items.name: Basic form table reference target lookup attribute
items.renders: Lookup attribute on the target record that is set to the reference record.
items.notes: Alternative to Relationship Name.

items.name: Basic form populate table reference lookup field
items.renders: If the lookup is on the form, it is pre-populated with the reference record.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Basic form table reference source type
values: Record Associated to Current Portal User=756150001
items.renders: How the reference record is located.
items.notes: Learn lists Query String and Current Portal User; the table reference labels the second choice Record Associated to Current Portal User. No default (-1). Reference Table Step applies to multistep forms only.

items.name: Basic form table reference query string name
items.renders: Query string parameter carrying the reference record identifier.
items.notes: With Source Type Query String.

items.name: Basic form table reference query string is primary key
items.renders: Whether the query string value is the reference primary key or another attribute value.
items.notes: Table reference default: true. When false, Query Attribute Logical Name is required.

items.name: Basic form table reference query attribute logical name
items.renders: Attribute used to query the reference record when the query string is not the primary key.
items.notes: Requires Query String Is Primary Key = false.

items.name: Basic form show read-only reference details
items.renders: Renders a read-only form with the reference record details at the top of the page.
items.notes: default: false. Requires Form Name.

items.name: Basic form reference read-only form name
items.renders: Form on the reference table used for read-only details.
items.notes: Requires Show ReadOnly Details.

items.name: Basic form geolocation enabled
items.renders: Enables the map control; for an editable empty address it prompts the user to share location and lets the pin be dragged.
items.notes: default: false. The Dataverse form needs a section named section_map (or ending with section_map). Site setting Bingmaps/credentials is required. Not visible in German Sovereign Cloud.

items.name: Basic form geolocation display map
items.renders: Whether the map is displayed.
items.notes: default: false. Learn: the map is only rendered when the form is displayed in a modal window; in read-only forms the address field is replaced by the map.

items.name: Basic form geolocation map type
items.renders: Mapping provider for the map control.
items.notes: default: Bing (756150000). Learn documents only Bing Maps site settings.

items.name: Basic form geolocation Address Line field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for Address Line.
items.notes: Field names vary with the schema.

items.name: Basic form geolocation City field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for City.
items.notes: Field names vary with the schema.

items.name: Basic form geolocation County field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for County.
items.notes: Field names vary with the schema.

items.name: Basic form geolocation State or Province field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for State or Province.
items.notes: Field names vary with the schema.

items.name: Basic form geolocation Country/Region field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for Country/Region.
items.notes: Field names vary with the schema.

items.name: Basic form geolocation Zip/Postal Code field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for Zip/Postal Code.
items.notes: Field names vary with the schema.

items.name: Basic form geolocation Latitude field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for Latitude.
items.notes: Field names vary with the schema.

items.name: Basic form geolocation Longitude field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for Longitude.
items.notes: Field names vary with the schema.

items.name: Basic form geolocation Formatted Address field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for Formatted Address.
items.notes: Field names vary with the schema.

items.name: Basic form geolocation Neighborhood field
items.renders: Maps the form field (attribute logical name) that the map control reads and writes for Neighborhood.
items.notes: Column only in the table reference; not listed among the add-geolocation address fields.

items.name: Basic form submit button label
items.renders: Label on the submit button.
items.notes: default: 'Submit' (Learn documents this option on the load-form step; the basic form column has the same name).

items.name: Basic form submit button busy text
items.renders: Label on the submit button while the submission is processing.
items.notes: default: 'Processing...' (per load-form-step page).

items.name: Basic form submit button CSS class
items.renders: CSS class applied to the submit button.
items.notes: default: 'button submit' (per load-form-step page).

items.name: Basic form next button label
items.renders: Label on the Next button between generated steps.
items.notes: Relevant with Auto Generate Steps From Tabs.

items.name: Basic form next button CSS class
items.renders: CSS class applied to the Next button.
items.notes: Relevant with Auto Generate Steps From Tabs.

items.name: Basic form previous button label
items.renders: Label on the Previous button between generated steps.
items.notes: Relevant with Auto Generate Steps From Tabs.

items.name: Basic form previous button CSS class
items.renders: CSS class applied to the Previous button.
items.notes: Relevant with Auto Generate Steps From Tabs.

items.name: Basic form settings (actions JSON)
items.renders: Holds the Additional Settings action configuration (Basic/Advanced Settings) for form actions.
items.notes: Memo column (display name Settings). Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action: Delete
items.renders: Button deletes the current record after a confirmation dialog.
items.notes: Shown only when the appropriate privilege is granted by table permissions. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action: Workflow
items.renders: Button runs an on-demand workflow against the current record.
items.notes: Shown only when the appropriate privilege is granted by table permissions. On list/subgrid pages a Workflow action needs a workflow and a Button Label, otherwise the button is not rendered. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action: Create Related Record
items.renders: Button creates a record related to the current record.
items.notes: Shown only when the appropriate privilege is granted by table permissions. Learn does not detail its sub-settings beyond the generic action/dialog settings. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action: Activate
items.renders: Button sets the record state to active.
items.notes: Shown only when the appropriate privilege is granted by table permissions. Learn recommends a workflow instead of Activate/Deactivate for standard tables with specific state/status codes (incident, opportunity, entitlement). Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action: Deactivate
items.renders: Button sets the record state to inactive.
items.notes: Shown only when the appropriate privilege is granted by table permissions. Learn recommends a workflow instead of Activate/Deactivate for standard tables with specific state/status codes (incident, opportunity, entitlement). Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form table-specific actions
items.renders: Extra action buttons for specific standard tables (Calculate Value of Opportunity, Cancel/Close/Reopen Case, Convert Quote to Order, Convert Order to Invoice, Generate Quote from Opportunity, Win/Lose Opportunity, Set Opportunity on Hold).
items.notes: Only offered for opportunity, incident, quote and salesorder tables. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action Confirmation Required
items.renders: Whether a confirmation dialog prompts the user when the action is selected.
items.notes: Per action. Learn documents these generic action settings on the list configuration page; the basic forms page states labels, sizes and other attributes can be overridden for form actions. Dialog settings apply only when confirmation is required. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action confirmation message
items.renders: Overrides the confirmation HTML message shown in the dialog.
items.notes: Per action. Learn documents these generic action settings on the list configuration page; the basic forms page states labels, sizes and other attributes can be overridden for form actions. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action button label
items.renders: Overrides the HTML label of the action button.
items.notes: Per action. Learn documents these generic action settings on the list configuration page; the basic forms page states labels, sizes and other attributes can be overridden for form actions. Required for Workflow actions. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action button tooltip
items.renders: Overrides the tooltip text of the action button.
items.notes: Per action. Learn documents these generic action settings on the list configuration page; the basic forms page states labels, sizes and other attributes can be overridden for form actions. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action button CSS class
items.renders: Adds a CSS class to the action button.
items.notes: Per action. Learn documents these generic action settings on the list configuration page; the basic forms page states labels, sizes and other attributes can be overridden for form actions. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action redirect to webpage
items.renders: Web page to redirect to after the action completes.
items.notes: Per action. Learn documents these generic action settings on the list configuration page; the basic forms page states labels, sizes and other attributes can be overridden for form actions. Highly recommended for Delete. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action redirect URL
items.renders: URL to redirect to after the action completes (alternative to Redirect to Webpage).
items.notes: Per action. Learn documents these generic action settings on the list configuration page; the basic forms page states labels, sizes and other attributes can be overridden for form actions. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action button placement and alignment
items.renders: Action buttons can be placed above or below the form and their alignment changed.
items.notes: In Insert mode you can't change a button's alignment or place an action button above the form. Learn does not list the option names or values. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog title
items.renders: Overrides the HTML in the dialog title bar.
items.notes: Per action confirmation/Delete dialog. Learn documents these dialog settings on the list and subgrid pages. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog primary button text
items.renders: Overrides the HTML of the primary (confirm/Delete) button.
items.notes: Per action confirmation/Delete dialog. Learn documents these dialog settings on the list and subgrid pages. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog close button text
items.renders: Overrides the HTML of the Close (Cancel) button.
items.notes: Per action confirmation/Delete dialog. Learn documents these dialog settings on the list and subgrid pages. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog dismiss button screen reader text
items.renders: Overrides the screen reader text of the Dismiss button.
items.notes: Per action confirmation/Delete dialog. Learn documents these dialog settings on the list and subgrid pages. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog CSS class
items.renders: CSS class(es) applied to the dialog.
items.notes: Per action confirmation/Delete dialog. Learn documents these dialog settings on the list and subgrid pages. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog title CSS class
items.renders: CSS class(es) applied to the dialog title bar.
items.notes: Per action confirmation/Delete dialog. Learn documents these dialog settings on the list and subgrid pages. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog primary button CSS class
items.renders: CSS class(es) applied to the primary button.
items.notes: Per action confirmation/Delete dialog. Learn documents these dialog settings on the list and subgrid pages. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog close button CSS class
items.renders: CSS class(es) applied to the Close button.
items.notes: Per action confirmation/Delete dialog. Learn documents these dialog settings on the list and subgrid pages. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog size
items.renders: Size of the action confirmation (e.g. Delete) dialog.
items.notes: default: Default for Delete/general dialogs. Learn gives labels only, not stored values. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog size: Default
items.renders: Action dialog rendered at Default size.
items.notes: Default for Delete/general dialogs. Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog size: Large
items.renders: Action dialog rendered at Large size.
items.notes: Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form action dialog size: Small
items.renders: Action dialog rendered at Small size.
items.notes: Learn does not state the JSON key names inside mspp_settings.

items.name: Basic form rendering: full page
items.field: adx_entityform on the web page (mspp_webpage.mspp_entityform lookup)
items.renders: Form renders inline in a web page associated through the Basic Form lookup (or placed with the entityform Liquid tag).
items.notes: A basic form must be associated with a web page to be viewable. The geolocation map is not rendered outside a modal window.

items.name: Basic form rendering: modal dialog from list/subgrid
items.field: Dialog settings on the list or subgrid action (not on the basic form)
items.renders: When a list or subgrid Create/Details/Edit action targets a basic form, the form opens in a dialog using that action's dialog settings (Loading Message, Title, Dismiss Button Sr Text, Size, CSS Class, Title CSS Class). The list hyperlink opens a dialog when View/Edit actions target a basic form.
items.notes: Create/Details/Edit dialog default size: Large (options Default, Large, Small). The action's Record ID Parameter Name must match the form's (default id). The geolocation map only renders in a modal window.

items.name: Basic form status
items.renders: Not stated on Learn; an inactive basic form is a deactivated record.
items.notes: statuscode Active=1, Inactive=2.

items.name: Basic form metadata type
items.renders: Selects which form element (attribute, section, tab, subgrid, notes, timeline) the metadata record augments or overrides; each type exposes its own option set.
items.notes: RequiredLevel ApplicationRequired. If two or more metadata records target the same attribute with conflicting actions, the record created first is applied and later ones are not.

items.name: Basic form metadata type: Attribute
items.renders: Modifies an individual attribute field: label, control style, prepopulation, set-on-save, lookup create form, validation and description.

items.name: Basic form metadata type: Section
items.renders: Overrides the label of a section on the Dataverse form identified by Section Name.

items.name: Basic form metadata type: Tab
items.renders: Overrides the label of a tab on the Dataverse form identified by Tab Name.

items.name: Basic form metadata type: Subgrid
items.renders: Enables list capabilities (view/item actions, dialogs, messages, column overrides) on an embedded subgrid that otherwise renders read-only.
items.notes: Without subgrid metadata an embedded subgrid renders as a read-only list (table permissions still required to see rows). See configure-basic-form-subgrid.

items.name: Basic form metadata type: Notes
items.renders: Configures the notes/timeline control on the form: create/edit/delete of notes and attachments, dialogs, messages, ordering.
items.notes: See configure-notes. Requires attachments enabled on the table, timeline control on the Dataverse form, and annotation table permissions.

items.name: Basic form metadata type: Timeline
items.renders: Configures the timeline control: create enabled, create dialog options, attachment location, accepted MIME/extension types, max file size.

items.name: Basic form (parent)
items.renders: Associates the metadata record with its basic form.
items.notes: Lookup to mspp_entityform; RequiredLevel ApplicationRequired.

items.name: Name
items.renders: Record name only; no documented rendering effect.
items.notes: String, max 100.

items.name: Attribute logical name
items.renders: Selects the attribute field to modify.
items.notes: Columns of type choices do not appear in the drop-down; type the logical name directly. Max length 100.

items.name: Attribute label
items.renders: Replaces the default label of the attribute on the form, per enabled language.
items.notes: Memo, max 10000; one value per enabled language pack.

values: Group Whole Number as Rank Order Scale Allow Ties=100000005

items.name: Attribute control style: Multiple Choice Matrix
items.renders: Grouped fields rendered as a multiple-choice matrix.
items.notes: Requires Group Name.

items.name: Attribute control style: Multiple Choice
items.renders: Grouped Two Option fields rendered as a multiple-choice question.
items.notes: Requires Group Name. Uses Multiple Choice Minimum/Max Selected Count and Multiple Choice Validation Error Message.

items.name: Attribute control style: Group Whole Number as Stack Rank
values: Group Whole Number as Stack Rank=100000008

items.notes: Requires Group Name.

items.name: Attribute control style: Render Lookup as Dropdown
items.renders: Lookup field rendered as a drop-down list.
items.notes: Learn lists the option only; rendering detail beyond the label is not described.

items.name: Attribute control style: Code component
items.renders: Field renders the code (PCF) component configured on the field in the model-driven form instead of the default control.
items.notes: Code component must be added to the field in the model-driven app form (client Web). Site version 9.3.3.x+ and starter package 9.2.2103.x+. Supported field types limited (Currency, DateAndTime, Decimal, Enum, Floating Point Number, Multiple, OptionSet, SingleLine.*, TwoOptions, Whole). Controls bound to multiple fields unsupported; Device capture/pick APIs and Utility unsupported. Design studio equivalent: Enable custom component.

items.name: Attribute group name
items.renders: Groups controls together and renders them as one composite control.
items.notes: Required by the group control styles (constant sum, rank order, multiple choice, matrix, stack rank). Max 100.

items.name: Attribute CSS class
items.renders: Adds a custom CSS class name to the control.
items.notes: Max 100.

items.name: Randomize option set values
items.renders: Option set options listed in random order.
items.notes: Only applicable to Option Set attributes. default: false.

items.name: Multiple choice minimum required selected count
items.renders: Minimum number of selections required in the multiple choice question.
items.notes: Only for control style Multiple Choice. Integer 0-100.

items.name: Multiple choice max selected count
items.renders: Maximum number of selections allowed in the multiple choice question.
items.notes: Only for control style Multiple Choice. Integer 0-100.

items.name: Constant sum minimum total
items.renders: Required minimum total for a constant sum response.
items.notes: Only for Group Whole Number as Constant Sum. Integer >= 0.

items.name: Constant sum maximum total
items.renders: Maximum permitted total for a constant sum response.
items.notes: Only for Group Whole Number as Constant Sum. Integer >= 0.

items.name: Ignore default value
items.renders: Field renders without its default value, e.g. Two Option Yes/No radios show no preselected answer.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Prepopulate type
items.renders: Provides a default value for the field when the form is loaded.
items.notes: DefaultFormValue -1 (none).

items.name: Prepopulate type: Value
items.renders: Field is set to the Value input when the form loads.
items.notes: Requires Value.

items.name: Prepopulate type: Today's Date
items.renders: Field is set to the current date and time when the form loads.

items.name: Prepopulate type: Current Portal User

items.notes: Requires From Attribute. Learn page labels this option "Current User's Contact"; table reference label is "Current Portal User".

items.name: Prepopulate value
items.renders: Value assigned to the field when the form loads.
items.notes: Used with Prepopulate Type = Value. Max 4000.

items.name: Prepopulate from attribute
items.renders: Contact attribute of the current portal user copied into the field on load.
items.notes: Used with Prepopulate Type = Current Portal User; requires signed-in user with contact.

items.name: Set value on save
items.renders: Assigns a value to the attribute when the form is saved.
items.notes: All attribute types except Unique Identifier. If the attribute is also on the form, the user's value is overwritten. default: false.

items.name: Set value on save type
items.renders: Selects how the on-save value is computed.
items.notes: Requires Set Value On Save = Yes. DefaultFormValue -1.

items.name: Set value on save type: Value
items.renders: Value input written on save.
items.notes: Requires Value.

items.name: Set value on save type: Today's Date
items.renders: Current date and time written on save.

items.name: Set value on save type: Current Portal User
items.renders: From Attribute of the current user's contact written on save.
items.notes: Requires From Attribute. Learn page label "Current User's Contact".

items.name: Set value on save value
items.renders: Value assigned to the attribute when the form is saved.
items.notes: Two Option: true/false; Option Set: integer value; Lookup: GUID. Max 4000.

items.name: Set value on save from attribute
items.renders: Contact attribute of the current portal user assigned to the field during save.
items.notes: Used with On Save Type = Current Portal User.

items.name: Lookup basic form for create

items.name: Required field validation error message

items.name: Geolocation validator error message

items.name: Constant sum validation error message

items.name: Multiple choice validation error message

items.name: Rank order no ties validation error message
items.renders: Overrides the rank order no ties validation error.

items.name: Field is required

items.name: Table permission: Name
items.renders: No visible rendering; descriptive name shown in the design studio Security workspace and Portal Management app.
items.notes: Primary name attribute; ApplicationRequired; max length 400.

states: records of this table accessible per access type and privileges
records of this table denied when no matching permission
items.name: Table permission: Table
items.renders: Selects the Dataverse table whose records the permission governs for forms, lists, Liquid and the portals Web API.
items.notes: ApplicationRequired; logical name, max length 250. Access to Dataverse records is restricted by default; without a permission for the table, components cannot access its records.

items.name: Table permission: Website
items.renders: No visible rendering; binds the permission to one website.
items.notes: Lookup to mspp_website; ApplicationRequired.

items.name: Table permission: Access type
items.renders: Determines which records of the table the selected privileges apply to for users in the associated web roles.
items.notes: Picklist mspp_entitypermission_mspp_scope; ApplicationRequired; DefaultFormValue -1 (no default). Design studio shows Global, Contact, Account, Self and Custom; Parent is only available in the Portal Management app (design studio adds child permissions instead).

items.name: Table permission access type: Global
items.renders: Privileges apply to all records of the table for users in the selected roles.
items.notes: Learn advises avoiding Global for sensitive data, especially when the table is exposed through the Web API.

states: only records related to the signed-in contact listed
items.name: Table permission access type: Contact
items.renders: Privileges apply only to records associated to the signed-in user (contact) through the selected Contact relationship.
items.notes: Requires Contact relationship (mspp_contactrelationship) between contact and the table. Learn example: a user with contact-level all access sees View/Edit/Delete on related records but only View on others reachable through a global read permission.

states: only records related to the signed-in user's account listed
items.name: Table permission access type: Account
items.renders: Privileges apply only to records associated to the signed-in user's account through the selected Account relationship.
items.notes: Requires Account relationship (mspp_accountrelationship) between account and the table.

states: related child records accessible when parent record accessible
no access when parent permission inactive
items.name: Table permission access type: Parent
items.renders: Child permission: privileges apply to records related, via the parent relationship, to records the parent table permission grants access to.
items.notes: Only selectable in the Portal Management app; design studio creates child permissions directly. Requires mspp_parententitypermission and mspp_parentrelationship. Polymorphic lookups are not supported for parent-child permissions.

items.name: Table permission access type: Self
items.renders: Privileges apply only to the signed-in user's own Contact record.
items.notes: Applies to the contact table (the user profile record).

items.name: Table permission access type: Custom (preview)
items.renders: Privileges apply only to records matching the FetchXML filter in Permission Fetchxml.
items.notes: Preview. Available only on sites enabled for enhanced authorization. Requires mspp_permissionfetchxml.

items.name: Table permission: Permission Fetchxml
items.renders: Filters which records a Custom access type permission applies to.
items.notes: Memo. Used with Custom access type. Only the FetchXML filter element is evaluated; other elements such as attribute are ignored.

items.name: Table permission: Contact relationship
items.renders: Relationship used to match records to the signed-in contact for the Contact access type.
items.notes: String (relationship name), max length 1000. Required when access type is Contact. New relationships must be published and synced in design studio before they appear.

items.name: Table permission: Account relationship
items.renders: Relationship used to match records to the signed-in user's account for the Account access type.
items.notes: String (relationship name), max length 1000. Required when access type is Account.

items.name: Table permission: Parent relationship
items.renders: Relationship between the parent permission's table and this child permission's table.
items.notes: String, max length 200. Used by child (Parent access type) permissions. Polymorphic lookups not supported.

items.name: Table permission: Parent table permission
items.renders: Makes this a child permission; access is evaluated through the parent permission.
items.notes: Self-lookup (relationship mspp_entitypermission_parententitypermission). Deactivating a parent leaves children active but ineffective; deleting a parent deletes its children. Child roles are inherited from the parent; a child role missing from the parent produces an error in design studio.

items.name: Table permission privilege: Read
items.renders: Controls whether the user can read a record. Lists, subgrids and forms show records only with Read; subgrids show the Access Denied message when the user cannot read the table; Web API reads follow it.
items.notes: Boolean, default: false. Notes Read requires Read on the annotation child permission. Privileges apply only to users in associated web roles; with EntityList/ShowRecordLevelActions=true lists show only the record actions the user is permitted.

items.name: Table permission privilege: Write
items.renders: Controls whether the user can update a record. List/subgrid Edit action shows an editable basic form only when Write is granted; target form read-only vs edit is determined by form mode and table permissions.
items.notes: Boolean, default: false. Notes Edit requires Write on the annotation child permission. Privileges apply only to users in associated web roles; with EntityList/ShowRecordLevelActions=true lists show only the record actions the user is permitted.

items.name: Table permission privilege: Create
items.renders: Controls whether the user can create a record. List/subgrid Create action opens a basic form to create a record only with Create.
items.notes: Boolean, default: false. Design studio prepopulates create and append to when adding a form. Notes Add requires Create plus Append (Append To on the parent permission). Privileges apply only to users in associated web roles; with EntityList/ShowRecordLevelActions=true lists show only the record actions the user is permitted.

items.name: Table permission privilege: Delete
items.renders: Controls whether the user can delete a record. List/subgrid Delete action permanently deletes the row only when Delete is granted.
items.notes: Boolean, default: false. Notes Delete requires Delete on the annotation child permission. Privileges apply only to users in associated web roles; with EntityList/ShowRecordLevelActions=true lists show only the record actions the user is permitted.

items.name: Table permission privilege: Append
items.renders: Controls whether the user can attach another record to the specified record; Append and Append To work in combination. Subgrid Associate action requires Append and AppendTo on the applicable tables.
items.notes: Boolean, default: false. Notes Add requires Append on the annotation child permission with Append To on the parent permission. Privileges apply only to users in associated web roles; with EntityList/ShowRecordLevelActions=true lists show only the record actions the user is permitted.

items.name: Table permission privilege: Append To
items.renders: Controls whether the user can append the specified record to another record; works with Append. Required on the parent table for notes/attachments and subgrid Associate.
items.notes: Boolean, default: false. Design studio prepopulates create and append to for new forms; SharePoint documents need Read and Append To on the form table. Privileges apply only to users in associated web roles; with EntityList/ShowRecordLevelActions=true lists show only the record actions the user is permitted.

items.name: Table permission: Web roles
items.renders: Privileges apply only to users in associated web roles. Associating the Anonymous Users role makes the table data visible to anyone.
items.notes: A table permission must be associated with at least one web role to take effect; design studio warns when saving without roles. Child permissions inherit roles from the parent. Export key name not stated on Learn.

items.name: Table permission: Status
items.renders: Inactive (deactivated) permissions are ineffective.
items.notes: statuscode Active=1, Inactive=2. A deactivated parent leaves child permissions active but ineffective.

items.name: Table permission enforcement across components
items.renders: Access to Dataverse records is restricted by default for forms, lists, Liquid and the portals Web API; users without permission get an error on basic forms and lists show only permitted records.
items.notes: Newer sites (9.3.7.x+) enforce table permissions on all lists regardless of Enable Table Permissions. EntityList/ShowRecordLevelActions=true shows only permitted record actions; when false and the table has multiple permissions, all actions show and unauthorized actions display an error. Web API GET across multiple levels of Parent/Contact/Account scopes can raise a CDS error (use FetchXML).

items.name: DateTime/DateFormat
items.renders: Overrides the date format used on the website (forms and lists).
items.notes: Value is a .NET custom date and time format string. Default: standard formats from the website language settings.

items.name: DateTime/TimeFormat
items.renders: Overrides the time format used on the website.
items.notes: Value is a .NET custom date and time format string. Default: website language settings.

items.name: DateTime/DateTimeFormat
items.renders: Overrides the full date and time format used on the website.
items.notes: Value is a .NET custom date and time format string. Default: website language settings. Field behavior (User Local, Date Only, Time-Zone Independent) controls time zone conversion separately.

items.name: Site/BootstrapV5Enabled
items.renders: Marks the site as Bootstrap version 5; removing it is part of reverting a site to Bootstrap version 3.
items.notes: Learn names the setting only in the revert steps (delete it, then clear server-side cache); value semantics are not documented. Bootstrap 5 site creation requires the enhanced data model.

items.name: Site/EnableCustomPluginError
items.renders: When true, custom Dataverse plugin error messages (message only, no stack trace) are shown on screen instead of a generic error on lists (record retrieval), basic forms (retrieve, create/update) and multistep forms (retrieve, create/update).
items.notes: default: false (treated as false when the setting is absent).

items.name: EnhancedFileUpload
items.renders: When true, the form file upload shows file name, type, size, an upload progress bar and a delete option; failed uploads (unsupported type, too many files) show an error message.
items.notes: New sites (release 9.3.2405.xx and later) are enabled automatically; existing sites opt in with true; false disables the new experience.

items.name: Site/EnableDefaultHtmlEncoding
items.renders: Controls whether the escape Liquid filter is enforced for user and request Liquid objects.
items.notes: Enforced by default from release 9.3.8.x; set False to allow these objects without escape.

items.name: DisableValidationWebTemplate
items.renders: When true, request validation is disabled site-wide, so content with unencoded HTML/script submitted in form fields is accepted instead of showing the generic 'potentially dangerous value(s)' error.
items.notes: default: false (request validation enabled). Applies to the entire website. Site Checker flags it when disabled. Saving notes containing HTML markup without the rich text editor requires disabling request validation.

items.name: Site/DisableFormDataSafeHtmlValidation
items.renders: When true only script blocks are validated in form data; setting false prevents any malicious code execution, including script blocks.
items.notes: default: true. Learn wording is terse; behavior beyond this is not documented.

items.name: KnowledgeManagement/DisplayNotes
items.renders: When true, knowledge articles are displayed with their note attachments, which also appear in search results.
items.notes: Learn is inconsistent on the default (attachment page: False; search overview table: True with description 'By default, it's set to False').

items.name: KnowledgeManagement/NotesFilter
items.renders: Only notes whose text starts with this prefix appear on the web page (form timeline / knowledge article attachments).
items.notes: default: *WEB*. Notes added through a form on a web page get the prefix automatically.

items.name: Timeline/RTEEnabled
items.renders: When true, adding or editing notes on a form uses the rich text editor; otherwise rich-text notes appear as HTML markup when edited.
items.notes: Learn shows creating it with value True; default not stated.

items.name: CustomerSupport/DisplayAllUserActivitiesOnTimeline
items.renders: Not described on Learn.
items.notes: Listed with value FALSE and no description.

items.name: Site/EnableContentSnippetTranslationForForms
items.renders: Enables content snippets for a custom language to be used for form translation.
items.notes: Set true before creating content snippets for a custom language. Default not stated.

items.name: UserTrace/Debug
items.renders: Enables the diagnostic setting so server-side errors and Liquid log messages appear in the Power Pages DevTools extension.
items.notes: Enabled by default for private sites; public sites set true.

items.name: SharePoint/MaxUploadSize
items.renders: Maximum per-file upload size for SharePoint documents on forms.
items.notes: Megabytes. default: 10; maximum 50.

items.name: SharePoint/MaxTotalUploadSize
items.renders: Maximum total upload size for SharePoint documents.
items.notes: Megabytes. Default not stated.

items.name: Search/Enabled
items.renders: When false, global search is off: with out-of-the-box templates the header search box and search page box are hidden and the search URL returns no results.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Search/EnableDataverseSearch
items.renders: Selects Dataverse search (true) or Lucene .NET search (false) for global search.
items.notes: default: True when absent; sites provisioned before 9.4.4.xx have False. Requires Dataverse search enabled in the environment.

items.name: Search/EnableAdditionalEntities
items.renders: Enables searching on other tables on the site.
items.notes: default: False. Requires Search/Enabled = True.

items.name: Search/Filters
items.renders: Adds drop-down filter options next to the global search box; labels show the table plural name (first table when several are listed).
items.notes: Format 'Label:logicalname1,logicalname2;Label2:logicalname3'. Default lists Content, Events, Blogs, Forums, Ideas, Issues and Help Desk groups. Site settings page writes it as search/filters.

items.name: Search/IndexQueryName
items.renders: Names the system view whose columns are indexed/searched; the first view column is the search result title.
items.notes: default: Portal Search. Tables without the view are not indexed. Lucene search needs a manual re-index after changing it.

items.name: Search/Query
items.renders: Adds weights and filters (Lucene syntax, @Query = user text) to the default search page box.
items.notes: Default is a Lucene expression boosting web pages and blog posts. Does not apply to custom searchindex Liquid pages. Clear the value to make Dataverse intelligent search work.

items.name: Search/Stemmer
items.renders: Language used by the search stemming algorithm.
items.notes: default: English.

items.name: Search/FacetedView
items.renders: When true, facets are shown with results on the search page.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Search/IndexNotesAttachments
items.renders: Indexes content of notes attachments in knowledge articles and web files so they appear in search results.
items.notes: default: False.

items.name: Search/RecordTypeFacetsEntities
items.renders: Groups tables under display names in the Record Type facet on the search page.
items.notes: Format 'DisplayName:logical1,logical2;DisplayName2:logical3'. Default groups Blogs, Forums, Ideas, Downloads.

items.name: Header/OutputCache/Enabled
items.renders: When true, Header web template output is cached instead of parsed and rendered on every page load; per-request parts must use {% substitution %}.
items.notes: default: true for new sites; disabled on upgraded sites. Enabling only via site settings without updating Header, Footer and Languages Dropdown templates makes parts render incorrectly with error messages.

items.name: Footer/OutputCache/Enabled
items.renders: When true, Footer web template output is cached.
items.notes: default: true for new sites; same template update caveat as the header.

items.name: Profile/ForceSignUp
items.renders: When true, users must update their profile information before they can access site content.
items.notes: default: False.

items.name: Profile/ShowMarketingOptionsPanel
items.renders: Shows the marketing communication preferences panel on the profile page.
items.notes: default: False.

items.name: Profile/ShowImage
items.renders: When true, authenticated users can upload a profile picture (saved to contact Entity Image, up to 10 MB).
items.notes: Default not stated.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/RequiresConfirmation
items.renders: True enables email confirmation and disables open registration.
items.notes: default: False.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/RequiresInvitation
items.renders: True enables the invitation code feature and disables open registration.
items.notes: default: False.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/Enabled
items.renders: Enables or disables all forms of user registration.
items.notes: default: True. Must be enabled for other registration settings to take effect.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/OpenRegistrationEnabled
items.renders: Shows or hides the sign-up form that lets any anonymous visitor create an account.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/InvitationEnabled
items.renders: Shows or hides the invitation code redemption form.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/CaptchaEnabled
items.renders: Shows captcha on the user registration page.
items.notes: default: False; may need to be created.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/LocalLoginEnabled
items.renders: Enables local username/email and password sign-in (and local password management on the profile Security page).
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/LocalLoginByEmail
items.renders: Local sign-in uses an email address instead of a username.
items.notes: default: False.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/ExternalLoginEnabled
items.renders: Enables external account sign-in, registration and managing external identities on the profile.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/RememberMeEnabled
items.renders: Shows a 'Remember me?' check box on local sign-in.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/TwoFactorEnabled
items.renders: Allows users with a confirmed email to opt into email-code two-factor authentication.
items.notes: default: False.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/RememberBrowserEnabled
items.renders: Shows a 'Remember browser?' check box on second-factor validation.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/ResetPasswordEnabled
items.renders: Enables the password reset feature.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/ResetPasswordRequiresConfirmedEmail
items.renders: Restricts password reset to confirmed email addresses.
items.notes: default: False.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/TriggerLockoutOnFailedPassword
items.renders: Records failed password attempts; when disabled accounts are not locked out.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/IsDemoMode
items.renders: Displays the password reset code and second-factor code to the user.
items.notes: default: False. Development only; requires a browser running locally to the web server.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/LoginButtonAuthenticationType
items.renders: Sign In button links directly to one identity provider instead of the local sign-in/provider selection page.
items.notes: Value is the provider AuthenticationType: listed values for OAuth 2.0; OpenID Connect uses the authority; WS-Federation uses the configured AuthenticationType value.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/TermsAgreementEnabled
items.renders: Shows a terms and conditions page users must accept before they are considered authenticated.
items.notes: default: false. Text comes from Account/Signin/TermsAndConditions* snippets.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/TermsPublicationDate
items.renders: Users who have not accepted terms after this GMT date/time are asked again at next sign-in; when empty, terms show on every sign-in.
items.notes: Requires TermsAgreementEnabled = true.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/DenyMinors
items.renders: Users flagged as minors see a message (Account/Signin/MinorNotAllowed* snippets) and no content.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/DenyMinorsWithoutParentalConsent
items.renders: Minors without parental consent see a message (Account/Signin/MinorWithoutParentalConsentNotAllowed* snippets) and no content.
items.notes: default: false.

items.name: Authentication/Registration/MobilePhoneEnabled
items.renders: Creating and enabling it causes an error.
items.notes: Not provided out of the box and not supported by Power Pages.

items.name: Webapi/<table>/enabled
items.renders: Enables or disables the /_api Web API for the table.
items.notes: default: False. Use the table logical name. Access still follows table permissions, web roles and column permissions; requests need a CSRF token.

items.name: Webapi/<table>/fields
items.renders: Comma-separated column logical names exposed through the Web API.
items.notes: Required unless UseFieldsFromView = True with an eligible view. Wildcard * is deprecated; requests for tables configured with * fail. Custom activity tables need at least one table-specific column or the request is treated as a wildcard ('Attribute All Columns is not enabled for Web Api').

items.name: Webapi/<table>/UseFieldsFromView
items.renders: Exposes columns displayed in the 'Power Pages Web API Columns' system view; combined with the fields setting when both exist.
items.notes: default: False. Site version 9.8.8.x+. Only primary-table displayed columns; lookups as _<column>_value; view changes take up to 5 minutes.

items.name: Webapi/error/innererror
items.renders: Includes InnerError details in Web API error responses.
items.notes: default: False.

items.name: DisableOdataFilter
items.renders: Not described on Learn beyond the release note.
items.notes: Learn documents no per-table Webapi/<table>/disableodatafilter. Release 9.8.8.x: DisableOdataFilter is no longer honored for new sites or existing sites that had not used it by August 11, 2026.

items.name: Page template: Type
items.renders: Controls whether the page renders through an ASP.NET .aspx rewrite page or a web template.
items.notes: default: 756150000 (Rewrite). Required.

items.name: Page template type: Rewrite
items.renders: Renders the default .aspx page given by Rewrite URL.
items.notes: entityform and webform Liquid tags render nothing inside a Rewrite-based page template.

items.name: Page template type: Web Template
items.renders: Renders the referenced web template (Liquid) as the page layout.
items.notes: Requires Web Template lookup.

items.name: Page template: Rewrite URL
items.renders: Path of the physical .aspx page rendering the content.
items.notes: Only default .aspx pages; shown only for Rewrite type. String max 100.

items.name: Page template: Web Template
items.renders: Web template used to render pages using this page template.
items.notes: Lookup to mspp_webtemplate; shown only for Web Template type.

items.name: Page template: Use Website Header and Footer
items.renders: True: web template renders content between the global header and footer. False: web template renders the entire response and Content-Type comes from the web template MIME Type.
items.notes: default: True.

items.name: Page template: Is Default
items.renders: Makes the template the default choice in client-side editing tools.
items.notes: No runtime page rendering change stated.

items.name: Page template: Table Name
items.renders: Page table type the template expects (usually adx_webpage); filters choices in front-side editing.
items.notes: Editing aid only.

items.name: Web template: Name
items.renders: Name used to include or extend the template from other templates.
items.notes: String max 100, ApplicationRequired.

items.name: Web template: Source
items.renders: Template source content, generally Liquid, rendered as page layout, header/footer or included content.
items.notes: Memo, max length 1048576.

items.name: Web template: MIME Type
items.renders: Sets the HTTP response Content-Type when a page template does not use the website header and footer (for example application/rss+xml).
items.notes: default: text/html when empty. String max 256.

items.name: Website: Header Template
items.renders: Overrides the global header; the template then renders primary navigation, sign-in/out links and search.
items.notes: Default header renders when empty. Output caching via Header/OutputCache/Enabled.

items.name: Website: Footer Template
items.renders: Overrides the global footer.
items.notes: Default footer renders when empty. Output caching via Footer/OutputCache/Enabled.

items.name: Built-in layout web templates
items.renders: Column layouts with breadcrumbs, page title and page copy; blocks main, aside, left_aside, right_aside.
items.notes: Other built-ins: page_copy, page_header, breadcrumbs, side_navigation, top_navigation, snippet, search, child_link_list_group, weblink_list_group. Learn does not document a 'Default studio template' record.

items.name: Liquid tag: entityform
items.renders: Fully renders a basic form by name.
items.notes: Only in web-template-based page templates (nothing renders in Rewrite templates). Only one entityform or webform per page; later ones are not rendered. Learn documents only the name parameter.

items.name: Liquid tag: webform
items.renders: Fully renders a multistep form by name.
items.notes: Same restrictions as entityform. Learn documents only the name parameter.

items.name: Liquid tag: entitylist
items.renders: Loads a list and exposes the entitylist object in the block; records render with a nested entityview.
states: block not rendered when list not found
items.notes: Provide only one of id, name or key (key parses as GUID else name). language_code defaults to the site Dataverse connection language.

items.name: Liquid tag: entityview
items.field: {% entityview [var =] id | logical_name+name, filter, metafilter, order, page, page_size, search, language_code %} (adx_source / mspp_source)
items.renders: Loads a Dataverse view with paginated records via the entityview object.
states: block not rendered when view not found
items.notes: Inside entitylist it inherits page size, filters and language and loads the list default view when no id/name. filter: 'user' or 'account'. metafilter only with entitylist. page_size default 10 outside a list.

items.name: Bootstrap version 3 vs 5
items.renders: Templates use standard Bootstrap components; version 5 adds Flexbox layout, accordion, offcanvas and RTL support.
items.notes: Environments default to Bootstrap 3; new sites use 5 once the enhanced data model is enabled. Learn gives no form/list-specific v3 vs v5 markup differences.

items.name: Liquid tag: include
items.renders: Includes another template by name; the included template sees the parent's variables and any named parameters as variables.
items.notes: The included source is generally a web template referenced by its Name.

items.name: Liquid tag: extends
items.renders: Template inheritance: renders the parent template, overriding the blocks the child defines.
items.notes: Must be the first content in the template and can only be followed by block tags.

items.name: Liquid tag: block
items.renders: Defines an overridable region; a parent block not overridden renders its own contents.
items.notes: Used with extends.

items.name: Liquid tag: fetchxml
items.renders: Queries Dataverse and exposes the results (results.entities, TableName, MoreRecords, TotalRecordCount and others) and the effective query (xml) on the variable.
items.notes: Self-closing FetchXML tags must not be used. Table permissions apply to the query.

items.name: Liquid object: snippets
items.renders: Loads a content snippet by name; null when no snippet has that name.

items.name: Liquid tag: editable
items.renders: Renders a CMS object (here a snippet) and makes it editable for users with content editing permission.
items.notes: type: html (default) or text; default rendered when the item has no value.

items.name: Portal Generic Error
items.renders: Custom content shown on the error page followed by error ID, date/time and portal ID.
items.notes: Not available out of the box; type Text or HTML; Liquid inside is not rendered.

items.name: Account/Register/RegistrationDisabledMessage
items.renders: Message shown when registration is disabled after an invitation was redeemed.

items.name: Account/Signin/TermsAndConditionsHeading
items.renders: Heading of the terms and conditions page.
items.notes: Text; default: Terms and Conditions.

items.name: Account/Signin/TermsAndConditionsCopy
items.renders: Body of the terms and conditions.
items.notes: HTML; empty by default.

items.name: Account/Signin/TermsAndConditionsAgreementText
items.renders: Agreement check box text.
items.notes: Text; default: I agree to these terms and conditions.

items.name: Account/Signin/TermsAndConditionsButtonText
items.renders: Terms page button label.
items.notes: Text; default: Continue.

items.name: Account/Signin/MinorNotAllowedHeading and MinorNotAllowedCopy
items.renders: Heading and HTML copy shown when a minor is denied.
items.notes: Heading default: Age Requirements; copy empty.

items.name: Account/Signin/MinorWithoutParentalConsentNotAllowedHeading and Copy
items.renders: Heading and HTML copy shown when a minor without parental consent is denied.
items.notes: Heading default: Parental Consent; copy empty.

items.name: Account/Conversion/PageTitle, PageCopy, SignInExternalFormHeading
items.renders: Text on the account migration page shown after sign-in with a deprecated identity provider.
items.notes: Defaults: Account Migration; an HTML migration explanation; Sign in with a supported account.

items.name: Account/Signin/AccountConversionIdentityUsedErrorHeading and Text
items.renders: Error shown when the new identity is already linked to another contact.
items.notes: Heading default: Account Conversion Error.

items.name: links/login
items.renders: Sign-in link text in the default Header template (falls back to resx Sign_In).

items.name: links/logout
items.renders: Sign-out link text in the default Header template (falls back to resx Sign_Out).

items.name: Site name, Logo URL, Logo alt text
items.field: Site name, Logo URL, Logo alt text (mspp_contentsnippet name)
items.renders: Header title, logo image and logo alt text.
items.notes: Code changes override design studio header edits.

items.name: Header/Search/Label and Header/Search/ToolTip
items.renders: Watermark text and tooltip of the header search box.
items.notes: Both default: Search.

items.name: Search/Title
items.renders: Heading above the search box on the search page in the default Header template.
items.notes: Rendered via editable snippets with a resx default.

items.name: Search/Default/FilterText
items.renders: Default text of the filter drop-down next to the search box.
items.notes: Default: All.

items.name: Search/Facet/* labels
items.field: Search/Facet/All, ClearConstraints, Downloads, Less, ModifiedDate, More, Product, Rating, RecordType, SortOrder/AverageUserRating, SortOrder/Relevance, SortOrder/Views (mspp_contentsnippet name)
items.renders: Labels for facets, facet buttons and sort options on the search results page.
items.notes: Defaults: All, Clear All, Downloads, Show less, Modified date, Show more, Products, Rating, Record Type, Average User Ratings, Relevance, View Count.

items.name: Page access control rule: Name
items.renders: Not rendered; descriptive name of the rule.
items.notes: String max 200, ApplicationRequired.

items.name: Page access control rule: Description
items.renders: Not rendered; optional description.
items.notes: Memo max 2000.

items.name: Page access control rule: Web Page
items.renders: The page the rule applies to; the rule also affects its child pages (the whole branch).
items.notes: Lookup to mspp_webpage, ApplicationRequired.

items.name: Page access control rule right: Grant Change
items.renders: Role members can publish content changes for the page branch; grant change also grants read that overrides restrict read rules.
items.notes: Managed in the Portal Management app, not design studio.

items.name: Page access control rule right: Restrict Read
items.renders: Only role members can view the page branch.

items.name: Page access control rule scope: All content
items.renders: All descendant content is included in security validation.
items.notes: Default.

items.name: Page access control rule scope: Exclude direct child web files
items.renders: Child web files directly related to the page are excluded from security validation (their descendants are not).

items.name: Page access control rule: Web roles
items.renders: Roles the rule applies to.

items.name: Content snippet: Name
items.renders: Key used by Liquid (snippets object, editable tag, include 'snippet') to place the value.
items.notes: String max 100, ApplicationRequired.

items.name: Content snippet: Display Name
items.renders: Label shown in the data editing UI.
items.notes: String max 250.

items.name: Content snippet: Value
items.renders: The content displayed on the site; plain text or HTML, may contain Liquid objects.
items.notes: Memo max 1048576. The export stores it in <name>.<lang>.contentsnippet.value.html.

items.name: Content snippet type: Text
items.renders: Text snippet.
items.notes: Default form value.

items.name: Content snippet type: HTML
items.renders: HTML snippet.

items.name: Content snippet: Content Snippet Language
items.renders: Makes the snippet language specific.
items.notes: Lookup to mspp_websitelanguage.

items.name: Web file
items.renders: Static file (stored as a note attachment) served at the parent page URL plus the partial URL.
items.notes: Parent Page recommended; access follows the parent page permissions (Learn: Create and manage web files).
